{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Confirm the parsing works
print("Revenue sample before parsing:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
print("Revenue sample after parsing:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Now, compute mean age, excluding -1 values
mean_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")"}
